title: How do I activate a pending Corporate Wellness Partnership enrollment?
content:
Activating a pending Corporate Wellness Partnership enrollment, once the employee's proof of employment has been reviewed in this conversation, transitions the enrollment's lifecycle status from applied to active. This action does not itself bill anything.

This is done using an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): activate_corp_enrollment_8f54bf3c.

Parameters:
- enrollment_id — the reference number of the enrollment to activate, read from the enrollment record returned when the enrollment was located or created.

Return: a confirmation of the enrollment reference number and that its lifecycle status is now active. No error condition beyond the enrollment not being found is defined here.
